description.value: Century Plaza Hotel is a 3-star all-suite downtown Vancouver property offering studio suites and one-bedroom suites ranging from 400 to 650 square feet, many with full kitchens. The hotel features an indoor pool, on-site steakhouse (C|Prime Modern Italian Steak and Wine), and a café (Beyond Coffee). Situated on Burrard Street, it is a short walk from Vancouver's main entertainment and shopping districts and approximately 1.5 km from BC Place.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates all OSM contact details: the privacy policy confirms the address as 1015 Burrard St, Vancouver, BC V6Z 1Y5, and the contact page lists the same front-desk number (604-687-0575). The FAQ covers car parking, baggage storage, and sightseeing tours but makes no mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific service; Wi-Fi is indicated by OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, fee=no) but is not confirmed in website text and so is marked null per the rules.
concerns: OSM name includes 'and Spa' but the website navigation lists 'A Salon' rather than a spa — possible name discrepancy or quiet rebranding.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active downtown Vancouver hotel, but neither the website nor the FAQ contain any evidence of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or cycling-specific amenities; it does not demonstrably meet the WWC required criteria.
